deployments_detail.use: "EBARA AI Chat" own generative-AI chatbot (Nov 2024) + "EBARA開発ナビ" design support

Waste-identification AI automatic crane system at waste-to-energy / incineration plants (Ebara Environmental Plant): camera + AI recognizes the state of refuse in the bunker and autonomously directs crane operation, automating ~90% of crane operating time. Jointly developed with Ridge-i; in operation since 2019. [Ridge-i]
deployments_detail.value: ~90% operatorless operation rate for the crane

deployments_detail.use: Advanced automated combustion-control system for municipal waste incinerators (Ebara Environmental Plant), working alongside the waste-identification AI crane to run the furnace autonomously without human intervention. Demonstration achieved 122 consecutive days of intervention-free continuous furnace operation. [Ebara Environmental Plant (in-house)]
deployments_detail.value: 122 consecutive days of intervention-free continuous furnace operation

deployments_detail.use: Knowledge-driven DX project: 'Ebara Brain' autonomous decentralized AI-agent platform (formalization, interview, expert and personal agents) plus 'EBARA Development Navigator', built on a Digital Triplet framework and running on-premises internal GPU clusters, to convert manufacturing tacit knowledge into formal knowledge. PoC on water-supply units: formalization agent reproduced 85% of manually-developed design processes with 83% relationship-prediction accuracy. Launched March 2026. [Ebara (in-house); collaboration with Showakai industry body]
deployments_detail.value: PoC: 85% of design processes reproduced; 83% relationship-prediction accuracy

deployments_detail.use: AI/IoT alliance with Ridge-i (100 million yen investment) targeting AI image-analysis to replace human visual inspection of product appearance, motion tracking of people/objects for production safety, and machine-operating-schedule optimization from environmental data. [Ridge-i]

EBARA Maintenance Cloud: IoT-sensor + cloud condition-monitoring service (wireless 'QiDe' vibration/temperature sensors) that remotely monitors pumps, blowers and motors 24/7/365, with data analysis for anomaly alerts and predictive maintenance, reducing on-site inspection labor and preventing sudden failures. [Ebara with JSOL (system integration)]

EBARA AI Chat: in-house generative-AI assistant deployed company-wide to domestic employees, combining EBARA technical/internal information with LLMs for document search, drafting and workflow support. Built on Google Cloud (Gemini API, Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Firestore, Document AI, BigQuery). Reached ~750,000 total uses by 2025. [Google Cloud (Gemini, Vertex AI, Document AI, Cloud Run, Firestore, BigQuery)]
deployments_detail.value: ~750,000 total uses by 2025; company-wide rollout to domestic employees

deployments_detail.use: AI-based condition-based maintenance (CBM) for the Fujisawa semiconductor-equipment facility, using Azbil's AI predictive-maintenance/CBM platform to support cleanroom operations and enable predictive maintenance of equipment such as dry vacuum pumps and chillers. [Azbil]

People-analytics pilot using InnerEye 'Sense Plus' EEG brain-wave measurement (via Macnica) to obtain objective biological data (concentration, attention, fatigue) for personnel planning and human-resource allocation decisions. Pilot involved 20 employees in planning/management departments. [InnerEye (via Macnica)]
